title: Manda ruin (god mode): hall -> ST12 sub 1's door -> ST13 sub 1 guardian (flag 0x5b1) -> ST13 2/4/5 -> the east ledge switch (flag 5) -> ST12 2/3/4 (switch, flag 6) -> sub 5 chest (blue card 0x3e4) + guardian (0x5b3) -> the terminal (0x5b6, script 0xf, the bridge) -> ST13 6/8/9/10 -> ST14 0..4 guardian (0x5b5) -> the key (0x3d0) -> ST24 sub 1
note: the blue card is not needed to reach ST13 (a3 ends in the hall; ST12 sub 1's door actor leads to ST13 sub 0), but it is needed for ST13 sub 6: the hall's west ledge exit 4 is only reachable over the bridge script 0xf raises. The card's room (ST12 sub 5) is behind the hall door 0x711 (flag 5: event volume message 0x10 on the east ledge, reached through ST13 sub 5) and sub 4 (flag 6: message 0x13).
